resources.string: Volume down: next step. Volume up: previous step.
Voice control in %1$s needs a download
The phone downloads the language so that it can recognise speech without the internet. The volume keys work meanwhile.
This phone cannot recognise %1$s by itself
Tandem only uses the phone’s own recognition, so voice control is off. Use the volume keys, or turn on “Use the phone’s speech service” under Handsfree.
Voice control is not working right now
The phone has no voice that can read this language aloud.
Cook without touching the screen. Tandem only listens while cook mode is shown.
The volume keys turn the steps: down for the next step, up for the previous one.
Say “next”, “back” or “repeat”. The phone recognises your voice by itself: no sound leaves your kitchen.
The phone reads a step when you turn to it. “Repeat” reads it again. If the media volume is off, cook mode shows “Raise volume”, because the volume keys turn the steps.
Done! Save the meal in the cook log when you are ready.
The download did not work. Try again in a while; the volume keys work meanwhile.
Often when it is on Wi-Fi and charging. Try again when it is done; the volume keys work meanwhile.
The phone’s speech service cannot recognise %1$s
Use the volume keys, or turn off “Use the phone’s speech service” under Handsfree.
This phone has no voice control in %1$s
Use English commands instead: “next”, “back”, “repeat”? The phone recognises them by itself.
This phone has no speech service
Install or turn on a speech service in the phone’s settings, or turn off “Use the phone’s speech service” under Handsfree. The volume keys work meanwhile.
Say “next”, “back” or “repeat”. With the phone’s speech service, your speech may be sent over the internet to that service.
For phones that cannot recognise %1$s by themselves: say “next”, “back” or “repeat”. Still recognised on the phone.

Listens in the app’s language with the phone’s regular speech service (for example Google’s), without the internet when the phone has the language downloaded. Otherwise your speech may be sent over the internet to that service. Off: only the phone’s own recognition, nothing leaves the phone.
The media volume is off, so reading aloud cannot be heard.
